{# LEFT: Table Card — uses workbench_table macro. min-w-0 overrides the flex item's default min-width:auto -- without it, a flex child containing a wide table cannot shrink below the table's intrinsic width, so the browser can't compute a correct scroll boundary for the table's own overflow-x-auto container. The visible symptom (H3) was the sticky "Actions" column's right:0 anchor landing mid-table instead of at the real scrolled edge, overlapping Status/Contract. #}
